transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?
I guess… mostly my sleep. It’s been pretty messed up lately. I’m either up half the night with my mind going, or I wake up way too early and don’t feel rested.
Have you been feeling sad or down lately?
Yeah… I guess I have. I wake up with this heavy, empty feeling, and sometimes even being in my own condo—something I worked hard for—just makes me want to cry.
Have you been feeling anxious or on edge lately?
I’m not really sure. I mean… maybe a little sometimes, but I haven’t really been paying attention to that.
Have you had any episodes where you suddenly felt extremely frightened or intensely anxious for no apparent reason?
Um… I don’t think so. Not like suddenly out of nowhere. I’ve felt tense, maybe, but I’m not sure I’d call it that.
Have you been enjoying things you usually like to do?
Not really. I stopped going to salsa class… and my paints are still out on the table, but I just look at them and don’t feel anything. It’s like they’re someone else’s stuff.
Have you experienced any episodes of intense fear or discomfort that reached a peak within minutes?
No… I don’t think so. I haven’t had anything that, like, peaks that fast. At least not that I’ve noticed.
Have you ever had a period of intense fear that came on very quickly?
No… not really. I mean, I get anxious sometimes, but I can’t think of a time where fear just hit me all at once like that.
Have you had any episodes where you felt an overwhelming fear or anxiety that seemed to come out of nowhere?
I don’t think so. I mean, I get uneasy sometimes, but not like… out of nowhere and overwhelming.
Have you ever felt like you were having a heart attack or thought you were going to die when you were feeling anxious?
No… I don’t think I’ve felt like I was dying or having a heart attack. Not that I can remember.
Have you ever had a sudden feeling of intense fear or anxiety that seemed to come out of nowhere?
I don’t think so… not suddenly like that. I’ve felt anxious, but I wouldn’t say it comes out of nowhere or feels intense like that.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your weight lately?
A little, maybe. I haven’t been eating dinner much—sometimes it’s just crackers while I’m doing my budget stuff. My work pants feel looser than they did a few weeks ago.
Have you been feeling unusually tired lately?

Yeah… I guess so. Even if I’m in bed all night, I still feel really heavy in the morning. Just walking in from the parking lot to the office feels like a lot, and by lunch my head feels kind of worn out.
Are there any activities that you still enjoy or find pleasure in?
Not really. I used to go to salsa class, and I haven’t been going. And my paints are still out on the table, but… I just look at them and don’t feel much. Like they’re not really mine.
Have you ever had an episode where you felt an intense fear or discomfort that included physical symptoms like a racing heart or sweating?
I don’t think so. I mean, I get stressed, but not like… suddenly with my heart racing or sweating or anything like that.
Have you been having any recurring thoughts that you can't seem to get out of your head?
Um… not really. I mean, I worry about things, but I don’t think there’s one thought that keeps looping or anything.
Are there any small things that still bring you some joy or pleasure?
Not much, honestly. I keep thinking maybe salsa or painting would, but I don’t go, and when I look at my paints sitting there, it’s just… nothing. Feels like they’re someone else’s.
Have you ever felt a sudden, intense fear that included symptoms like a racing heart or shortness of breath?
No… I don’t think I’ve had that. Not like a sudden fear with breathing or my heart racing.
Are you still interested in doing things you used to enjoy?
Not really. I stopped going to salsa, and my paints are still out on the table… but when I look at them, I just don’t feel anything. It’s like they’re not even mine.
Have you ever had an episode where you felt an intense fear or anxiety that included physical symptoms like a racing heart, sweating, or shortness of breath?
I don’t think so. I mean… I get anxious sometimes, but not like an episode with sweating or not being able to breathe or anything like that.
